text:
Maya: Anyone up for a mellow gravel ride + microbrew stop Sunday morning? thinking 9am, 25mi loop → picnic tables by the river. :bike: :beer:
Alex: Oooo tempted. Can we make it 8? kid's soccer at 1. If not I'll join for the brewery part later :)
Jamal: count me in for the ride. I can bring a cooler and some snacks. also got a JBL speaker. :sunglasses:
Tess: I might be around! Not sure about distance—any shorter route options? Also where exactly is the meetup?
Maya: Meet at Greenway Park parking lot (near the east gate). Short route: 12mi loop option, meet same time. Link to GPX: https://strava.example/route/12345
Alex: If I can't do the ride I'll swing by the brewery ~ noon. Which brewery? (I have a toddler so timing is everything)
Maya: Bramble & Barrel across from the river bridge. Jamal can save a seat. :thumbsup:
Jamal: @Alex I'll bring a folding high chair (joke). seriously i'll grab a table. also parking's a bit tight, carpool recommended.
calendar-bot: Event created: 'Sunday Gravel + Bramble & Barrel' Sun 9:00 AM — Guests: Maya, Jamal ; RSVP: open
Tess: Sounds fun — RSVP'd. If weather turns I can host an indoor boardgame + chili fallback at my place. :chili_pepper:
Maya: Plan: ride 9am, brewery noon, overflow boardgames at Tess if rain. @everyone who's in, drop a :biking_man: or :beer:
Alex: :beer: (planning to join at noon)
Jamal: :biking_man: + :beer:
Tess: :game_die: if shelter needed
Maya: Awesome — see you all!
